alerts.title: Infrastructure alerts
alerts.description: An infrastructure alert tells Root when something in the platform fails, for example when the daily audit anchor could not be published.
alerts.rule: Choose where they are sent. At least one channel must stay on.
alerts.defaults: No configuration has been saved yet: the defaults apply (email and Telegram on) until you save.
alerts.channels.email.label: Email
alerts.channels.email.description: Each active Root receives it in her language.
alerts.channels.telegram.label: Telegram
alerts.conflict: Someone else changed these settings while you were editing. The current values were loaded; review them and save again.
